Ava: quick follow-up from todays all-hands pricing section. drop questions about credits, quotas, and bursts here.
Rohit: customer asked: do Hosted credits apply to Dedicated usage in hybrid setups?
Maya: no — Hosted credits are for the public API only. Dedicated is contract/reserved capacity; billing can be consolidated but units dont mix.
Liam: whats the default behavior when a route exceeds its quota? 429s or queuing?
Kenji: self-serve = 429 + Retry-After header. Dedicated can opt into a short queue (configurable, up to 10s) or automatic fallback to a cheaper model variant.
Rohit: are grace bursts free?
Maya: grace bursts consume credits. we offer a small auto-grace once per billing period for accounts in good standing; larger bursts require a support request.
Liam: SDKs — will they surface Retry-After and help with backoff?
Kenji: yes. SDKs return Retry-After and emit a client event `rate_limit.hit`. were adding a helper for jittered exponential backoff in the next SDK sprint.
Rohit: what about one-off credit grants for demos? process?
Maya: Support handles them. include expected duration, estimated volume, and demo date. approvals usually same-day for internal sales demos.
Ava: action items: Maya to publish a short KB with examples (token calc + streaming guidance) by EOD tomorrow; Kenji to add SDK backoff helper to the sprint board; product to prototype a "credits remaining" overlay in Console.
deploy-bot: KB stub created: https://intranet.redwood/KB/ah-pricing-credits-stub
Rohit: thanks — dropping follow-ups here as they come. :thumbsup:
